name: tr-tax-vat-rates
title: VAT rates of Türkiye
description: The value added tax (KDV) rates of Türkiye set by Decree 2007/13033 (general rate, list I and list II rates, with the rates before 2023-07-10), and the items of list I (1%) and list II (10%) in the consolidated text published by GİB, including the customs tariff lines named in four of the items.

sources.title: Güncel KDV Oranları: Mal ve Hizmetlere Uygulanacak Katma Değer Vergisi Oranlarının Tespitine İlişkin Karar (2007/13033), consolidated text with amendments up to Presidential Decree 9126 (in force 2024-11-15), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-09
tr-customs-gtip (TÜİK GTİP 2026), this repository: used for in_gtip_2026

fields.name: rate_type
fields.description: general for taxable supplies not in either list (Decree art. 1(1)(a)); list_i for supplies in list I (art. 1(1)(b)); list_ii for supplies in list II (art. 1(1)(c)).

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day the rate applies under Decree 2007/13033. 2007-12-31 is the day after the Decree was published; rates in force before the Decree are not covered.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day the rate applied. Empty for the rates in force.

fields.name: applies_to
fields.description: What the rate applies to, in English.

fields.name: legal_basis
fields.description: Provision and amending decree, as given in the consolidated text.

fields.name: list
fields.description: I for list (I), taxed at 1%; II for list (II), taxed at 10%.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Section of list I: A (Gıda maddeleri, food) or B (Diğer mal ve hizmetler, other goods and services). Empty for list II, which has no sections.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Item number (sıra) within the list or section, as printed.

fields.name: rate_percent
fields.description: The rate of the list today: 1 for list I, 10 for list II. The item text can carry exceptions that move some supplies to another rate.

fields.name: status
fields.description: repealed when the item was removed and only the repeal note remains in the text; in_force otherwise.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Full text of the item in Turkish as in GİB's consolidated text, including sub-items, amendment notes such as '(2016/9542 sayılı Kararname ile değiştirilen sıra. Yürürlük: 25/11/2016)' and GİB's footnote numbers in parentheses. Line breaks are joined with a space. For items with a tariff table the table is part of the text; see vat-rate-list-tariff-lines for the lines.

fields.name: list
fields.description: List of the item the line belongs to. References vat-rate-list-items.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Section of the item, as in vat-rate-list-items.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Item number. The tables are in list I section B item 17 (machinery for financial leasing) and list II items 28 and 29 (agricultural and other machinery) and 33 (furniture).

fields.name: gtip_printed
fields.description: Customs tariff position exactly as printed, for example 84.02, 8418.69 or 8428 90.71 00 00. Positions refer to the tariff edition named in the item, not to the current one.

fields.name: gtip
fields.description: The same position as digits only (4, 6 or 12 digits), comparable with code in tr-customs-gtip.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of the position as printed in the table, with GİB's footnote numbers.

fields.name: in_gtip_2026
fields.description: true when gtip exists as a code in the 2026 GTİP nomenclature (tr-customs-gtip); false when the position has since been renumbered or split.
